title: Blog Overview Page
userStory: As a an online store visitor, I want to view a neatly organized overview of all blog posts,, so that I can quickly browse through content, discover topics of interest, and engage more with the brand
summary: Blog overview page template for browsing posts with responsive grid layout and pagination or infinite scroll.
features: Responsive grid layout with 3 columns on desktop and stacked on mobile
Optional featured post section displayed above the main grid
Configurable pagination or infinite scroll navigation
Dynamic integration with Shopify blog engine supporting multiple blogs
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Blog Overview Page template provides a central hub for store visitors to discover and browse blog content, improving brand engagement and supporting customer conversion through content marketing.

## Use Cases

- Display a curated overview of all blog posts with customizable H1 title and optional subline
- Highlight a featured post above the main content grid to draw attention to important articles
- Present blog post previews in a responsive 3-column grid (desktop) or stacked layout (mobile)
- Enable seamless content navigation through pagination or infinite scroll options
- Integrate dynamically with Shopify's blog engine, supporting stores with multiple blogs

## Design Rationale

The template uses semantic HTML elements (`<article>`, `<h2>`, `<time>`) for each post preview to ensure accessibility and SEO optimization. The flexible layout system adapts to different screen sizes while maintaining visual hierarchy, and the content slot after pagination allows for newsletter signups or promotional banners.
shortDescription: Central hub for store visitors to discover and browse blog content. Post previews include featured image (configurable ratio), title, excerpt (~100 words), and read more link. Uses semantic HTML elements (article, h2, time) for accessibility and SEO optimization. Content slot after pagination allows for newsletter signups or promotional banners. Admins assign featured images, tags, and excerpts via Shopify admin.
